name: Flinders General Store
signature: A Cook Street grocery and deli for takeaway coffee, freshly made sandwiches and picnic provisions.
editorNote:
On Cook Street, Flinders General Store is a grocery stop for the day ahead. Pick up a freshly made sandwich and takeaway coffee, or stock up on fruit, bread and pantry staples.

It’s a useful stop before a picnic or when you’re shopping for a weekend in Flinders. The store doesn’t take table bookings. For a larger grocery shop, the store offers click and collect through its website.
whyWeGo: Pick up lunch to take away and provisions for later in one Cook Street stop.
ifOnlyOneThing: Pick up a freshly made sandwich to take on your Flinders outing.

heroImage.alt: From a timber pier, waves breaking over a seaweed-covered rock shelf, boats moored on the bay and a green headland beyond.
